items.summary: The discovery by security company Calif shows A.I.’s ability to find gaping security holes in popular software. The Java flaw pointed to vulnerabilities in systems used by nearly all Fortune 500 companies.

items.title: Review: SEC Is Probing Nvidia Amid Jensen Huang’s Exit, WSJ Reports
items.summary: The Securities and Exchange Commission is investigating Nvidia Corp., the Wall Street Journal reported Tuesday, as the company grapples with fallout from the exit of former Chief Executive Officer Jensen Huang.

items.title: Review: With House Democratic Majority Still Growing, Recounts Are Starting in Closest Races
items.summary: The exact size of the Democratic majority in Congress was undetermined as recounts were sought in two races in North Carolina and one in Minnesota two weeks after the elections.

items.summary: Bond traders risk facing a short squeeze after reloading bearish positions, as renewed jitters around artificial intelligence and a spate of technical disruptions reignite a flight to safety.

items.title: Review: B3 to Add Brazil Stocks Listed Abroad to Aid Ailing Local Market
items.summary: Brazil’s exchange operator B3 SA will incorporate shares of Brazilian companies listed abroad to the nation’s benchmark equity index starting next year in a push to boost liquidity after years of de-listings in the local market.

items.summary: Iowa’s governor-elect, Rob Sand, ran on a platform criticizing the two-party system. How will he translate his campaign message into reform?

items.title: Review: Kazakhstan Has Given Over $1 Billion of Loans Lending to emerging metal tycoon
items.summary: Kazakh investment holding Baiterek lent more than $1 billion to two mining companies run by Nurlan Artykbayev, underlining the state support provided to businessmen who rose to prominence under President Kassym-Jomart Tokayev.

items.title: Review: SpaceX Debt for AI Chips to Hit Market as Soon as This Week
items.summary: A portion of $40 billion in debt financing to pay for artificial intelligence chips for SpaceX may start being sold as soon as this week, with Goldman Sachs Group Inc. and Apollo Global Management Inc. serving as underwriters on the expected deal, according to a person with knowledge of the matter.
